audit_mul_base.reason: Completed BINSEC 0.11.3/Z3 5.3.3 check for a symbolic canonical nonzero scalar and the fixed public generator loaded from this binary. RV32 ABI inspected: a0 return pointer, a1 scalar pointer, a2 generator overwritten inside wrapper; normalized variant uses a 120-byte stack/output point. No arbitrary point or hardware claim.
audit_mul_base.memory_scope: Fixed public, disjoint scalar/output buffers and stack; fixed public generator and readonly data from the image. No speculative/cache-content observation.
audit_mul_base.review_note: ct-pr, compared with finalized Apple follow-up 37f65e1. Source changes remove scalar-invert unwrap; explicit wrapper input types, per-case taint receipts and separately gated scalar controls change the harness. Inventory/build-driver/configuration pins refreshed. All reachable deltas inspected: inversion masking/conditional-select, relocated code/data addresses, and unreachable x86 audit_y_even padding. Both RV32 suites were rerun with ten scalar-only roots (dot lengths 0..2) and two fixed-generator multiplication roots; strict x86 taint/control evidence is separately pinned. See strict-gate-changes.json for exact differences. Hardware and unresolved-transfer gaps remain. Final inventory also binds the completed fixed-generator models; code and other configuration hashes are unchanged by this metadata extension.
